sqlQuery.name: TranscriptProducts
sqlQuery.sql: SELECT va.source_id, va.project_id, t.gene_source_id, t.transcript_source_id, t.gene_product, t.strand, p.pos_in_cds, p.pos_in_protein, p.codon, p.pos_in_codon, p.product, CASE p.matches_ref_codon WHEN 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS matches_ref_codon, CASE p.matches_ref_product WHEN 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS matches_ref_product, p.strain_count, p.hgvs_p FROM apidb.VariationTranscriptProduct p, jbrestel.VariationAttributes va, ApidbTuning.TranscriptAttributes t WHERE va.sequence_source_id = p.sequence_source_id AND va.location = p.location AND t.na_feature_id = p.na_feature_id

sqlQuery.name: PredictedEffects
sqlQuery.sql: SELECT va.source_id, va.project_id, e.allele, t.gene_source_id, t.transcript_source_id, e.impact, e.effect, e.hgvs_c, e.source FROM apidb.VariationEffect e JOIN jbrestel.VariationAttributes va ON va.sequence_source_id = e.sequence_source_id AND va.location = e.location LEFT JOIN ApidbTuning.TranscriptAttributes t ON t.na_feature_id = e.na_feature_id
